extracted.intended_audience: creative writing instructors, evaluators/raters, and NLP researchers studying story generation
extracted.subtask_short: creative writing rubric for short stories
extracted.subtask_description: A 10-item rubric designed to assess creative writing scripts (short stories) used in university creative writing courses and in an empirical study comparing human and LLM-generated stories. It measures general craft (items 1–5) and task-specific proficiency (items 6–10).

rubrics_metrics.name: Overall / holistic / cohesive readability
rubrics_metrics.description: Overall/ holistic/ cohesive readability of the story (not just a compilation of elements).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates whether the story reads as a coherent whole rather than a disconnected set of features. Includes flow, narrative unity, and whether the piece holds together as a cohesive reading experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of key narrative elements
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of key narrative elements - vocabulary choice, imagery, setting, themes, dialogue, characterisation, point of view.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses the presence and quality of core narrative building blocks: apt vocabulary and imagery, credible and evocative setting, coherent themes, natural-sounding dialogue, well-drawn characters, and consistent/appropriate point of view. Look for richness and aptness of choices rather than mere inclusion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Structural elements and presentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Structural elements and presentation which reflects the control of structural elements such as spelling, grammar, punctuation, paragraphing, and formatting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers technical craft: mechanical correctness, paragraphing, formatting, and visible control of presentation. Scores penalize lack of basic writing mechanics or careless presentation that distracts the reader.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overall plot logic
rubrics_metrics.description: Overall plot logic: hook, conflict, initial crisis, rising and falling action, denouement/ resolution (Freitag’s pyramid).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates narrative structure and causal logic: whether the story establishes a hook, develops conflict and crises, shows a coherent arc (rising/falling action), and resolves (denouement). Judges coherence and effectiveness of plot progression.

rubrics_metrics.name: Creativity / innovation / originality
rubrics_metrics.description: Creativity/innovation/originality — (emphasis on novelty, credibility, avoidance of cliché and derivative/imitative tropes).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measures how original and inventive the story is: fresh ideas, surprising developments, credible worldbuilding, and avoidance of clichés or derivative tropes. (Page wording is fragmented; overall intent is to reward novelty and avoid imitation.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Incorporation of the John Kennedy Toole style
rubrics_metrics.description: Incorporation of the John Kennedy Toole style of writing using the indicators/ characteristics listed below.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Raters were given detailed information about Toole-style indicators (protagonist, setting, imagery, tone, etc.) drawn from a study guide (link provided). This item measures how well the piece evokes the specified authorial style using the provided characteristics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understanding and habitation of the epic genre
rubrics_metrics.description: Understanding and habitation of the epic genre of heroic/legendary adventure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses whether the story successfully operates within epic/heroic/legendary adventure conventions: scope, tone, stakes, and the feel of heroic narrative. Judges adherence to or effective subversion of genre expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Description and credibility of a single combat scene
rubrics_metrics.description: Description and credibility of a single combat scene.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates the vividness, clarity, and believability of a described combat/action scene: choreography, sensory detail, pacing, and plausibility within the story's world.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accurate inclusion of two main characters
rubrics_metrics.description: Accurate inclusion of two main characters Ignatius J. Reilly and a pterodactyl in action and description (see below for character description).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Task-specific requirement: the story must include and accurately portray the two specified main characters (one being Ignatius J. Reilly and one a pterodactyl) in action and description, following provided character descriptions/expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of a characteristically dark humorous tone
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of a characteristically dark humorous tone.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses tone: whether the story employs dark humor appropriately and consistently, balancing morbidity and comic effect in a way consistent with the task's stylistic goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rubric structure and scoring allocation
rubrics_metrics.description: The rubric was designed for assessment in university creative writing courses: criteria 1–5 measure general creative writing capacities, and criteria 6–10 measure specific task-related proficiency. Each of the ten criteria is awarded 10 points out of a total 100 points.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intent: measure quality of writing craft and avoid formulaic, rule-based writing. The rubric separates general craft from task-specific requirements to allow both broad and targeted evaluation; total score sums the ten 10-point items.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1–10 rating scale ranges (Emerging / Competent / Sophisticated)
rubrics_metrics.description: The 1–10 scale is divided into three ranges: Emerging (1–4), Competent (5–8), Sophisticated (9–10).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emerging (1–4): early grasp of storytelling elements but falter in execution or depth; corresponds to novice writers needing feedback. Competent (5–8): good grasp of evaluated principles with room for improvement; effectively engages readers. Sophisticated (9–10): exceptional mastery producing compelling and memorable results. Use these ranges to map numerical scores to qualitative performance bands.
